race.comment: Wide open race but veteran mare GRANDEUR ROSE (9) is going better than form suggests. Runner-up latest in a top run off a wide gate but drawn far better this time. Will box seat and can find winning form. CAPIANA (2) was a close-up fourth last time and is overdue for a win. Best form stacks up. COSMIC PROPORTIONS (4) has a tricky gate to overcome but goes very well course and distance and will give a sight. OUTDOOR CAT (6) was off best last time but in the minors the start prior. Can bounce back. ENERGIA (8) was a fresh-up winner then on speed and run over the last two. Tough gate here but will push forward and give a sight. Has more upside than most.
